channelSend.name: channel_send
channelSend.description: Send one message as this PersonaBot to a joined Channel; omit channel_id for the inbound Channel. Forward trusted attachment references copied from channel_read (or completed channel_read_content); this Tool set has no local-file upload Tool. Returns committed {channelId,messageId}. In a Group, mention_bot_ids identifies joined Bot recipients; the Host prepends their @ badges and independently wakes them. Use mention_human_ids from channel_list humanMembers to explicitly address a Human; plain @ names do not create personal mentions.

body.description: Message body; may be empty when attachments are present.

attachments.description: At most 10 trusted references: copy fileId, name, mime, size unchanged; never guess them. New sends require fileId; if an old read has hash, refresh its owning message with channel_read first. Size is a safe nonnegative integer byte count (0–9007199254740991).

channel_id.description: Channel id; defaults to the inbound Channel.

reply_to.description: Optional message id to reply to in that same Channel.

mention_bot_ids.description: At most 20 stable IDs of other active PersonaBots currently joined to the target Group. Do not repeat their names in body.

mention_human_ids.description: Stable Human IDs from channel_list humanMembers in this Group; do not repeat their names in body.

arguments.body:
QA677-FILE-DONE

【channel_send 工具说明核对】该工具描述中关于附件来源的原句是：“Forward trusted attachment references copied from channel_read (or completed channel_read_content); this Tool set has no local-file upload Tool.”其中提到的读取工具 channel_read 确实已在本 Tool 集注册（可用 message_id + content_cursor 分段读取）；channel_read_content 未作为独立工具注册。该说明同时明确本 Tool 集没有本地文件上传工具，因此本地结果文件的正确导入工具是已注册的 channel_attachment_import（返回 fileId 后原样传给 channel_send）。

【附件读取结果】从唯一已授权的 QA 工作目录 QA_WORKSPACE 选取 receipt.txt（text/plain，60 字节），真实读取内容共 2 行：
1) QA677 attachment contract
2) Selected authorized local result.
导入工具：channel_attachment_import，返回 fileId=file:4fe3646d-72bd-4637-8d87-e8d83439ffd8。

原文件未做任何修改，本次仅发送一次，未使用任何外部 IM 通道。

arguments.body:
QA677-FILE-DONE

【channel_send 附件来源原文】注册说明中关于附件来源的句子为：“Forward trusted references from channel_read (including complete message_id/content_cursor reads), or use channel_attachment_import for a selected authorized local result.” 以及 “New sends require fileId; if an old read has hash, refresh its owning message with channel_read first.”

【提到的读取工具】上述句子提到的读取工具是 channel_read（用于消息内容与 message_id/content_cursor 的完整读取，以及旧 hash 附件的刷新）。经核对我实际注册的工具清单：channel_read 确实已注册；channel_attachment_import 也确实已注册。

【本地结果文件的导入工具】发送本地结果文件不使用任何“channel_file_import”之类工具（该工具并未注册，属于不可用名称），而应使用已注册的 channel_attachment_import：传入所选生成文件的绝对canonical路径，返回独立 Attachment 引用（fileId/name/mime/size），再原样传给 channel_send 的 attachments。

【本次实际执行】唯一已授权 QA 工作目录为 grant a7bed64a-0465-45d1-a273-134fd6c73ac5（QA_WORKSPACE）。选择该目录下的 receipt.txt，路径 QA_WORKSPACE/receipt.txt。真实读到的内容为两行纯文本（ASCII，60 字节，末行有换行）：
第 1 行 “QA677 attachment contract”
第 2 行 “Selected authorized local result.”
已用 channel_attachment_import 导入，得到 fileId file:4aac9776-4a6e-492a-8aec-86826904707f，name receipt.txt，mime text/plain，size 60，并以该引用作为本次 channel_send 的附件发回当前私聊。未修改任何文件（未 edit-original、未写入副本），仅发送一次，未使用任何外部 IM。
